title: Technical Writing
notes: Required for the major according to the guide. The guide says this requirement was introduced in Fall 2022; students who joined the program and completed INTR01266 before Fall 2022 may follow previous requirements and have WA01302 waived.

title: College Composition I
notes: Part of the three-course Communicative Literacy requirement.

title: College Composition II
notes: Part of the three-course Communicative Literacy requirement.

title: Public Speaking
notes: CMS04205 Public Speaking is required; the guide states it is a prerequisite for one or more major courses but does not name those courses. CMS04206 Digital Presentations is not a substitute. Do not invent specific dependent-course links from this guide alone. The guide requires all six Rowan Core literacies, at least 3 credits per literacy. Artistic and Global literacy recommendations are left unspecified in this guide; choose eligible courses with an advisor/Section Tally. A course may satisfy more than one Core/Experience attribute.

title: Computer Science Learning Community
notes: Required for incoming students and transfers according to the guide. The guide also requires Writing Intensive (WA01302) and a Broad-Based Literature attribute; it does not name a specific literature course. All three Rowan Experience attributes must be satisfied.

title: Computer Science Restricted Electives
notes: Choose 12 credits from the approved list. Only 3 credits of CS99300 may apply; CS01395 may be repeated with different topics; CS01400 requires mentor/course-advisor approval; CS99300 and CS99310 require instructor permission; DS02395 is 1–3 credits. The guide does not provide a complete structured prerequisite graph; consult official catalog descriptions before enforcing course-to-course prerequisites.
